benchmark: user-only Mel rolling-window sweep against same offline 10-second tower output

runtime.backend: Gemma4AudioModel CUDA Graph; one graph per fixed window/mask shape

precision_baseline.tower_dtype: checkpoint-loaded BF16 (FP32 attention internals verified from installed source)

runtime.tf32_ablation: temporary process-local torch.set_float32_matmul_precision('high'); restored after the isolated graph experiment

contract.window_update: window_rows-8 prior rows (capped by real history) plus 8 new user Mel rows
contract.offline_reference: same real WAV, resampled and trimmed to 10.0s, full 1000-row offline Mel, same loaded tower/checkpoint
contract.mask_ablation: W1024 all-true (historical behavior) versus false for invalid leading zero-pad rows
contract.prefix_ablation: exact user-Mel prefixes of 8,16,...,1000 rows, no padding, select last 2 rows

notes: All graph windows use the same real user-only Mel stream; no assistant-history features enter these measurements.
Graph copy+replay timing copies from a pre-staged GPU tensor into static graph buffers; CPU-to-GPU transfer and Mel extraction are excluded.
Startup and steady metrics use the same 250-pair offline reference; steady begins only when the complete requested prior Mel context exists.
A fixed Mel window resets the tower positional coordinate system at the window start; a larger window is measured, not assumed equivalent.

audio_tower_source_geometry.subsample_module: Gemma4AudioSubSampleConvProjection; two Conv2d temporal kernel=3 stride=2 padding=1 layers; receptive field=7 Mel rows, stride=4
audio_tower_source_geometry.attention_source_behavior: Gemma4AudioAttention manually casts q/k/v to FP32, uses matmul for q-k and relative positions, then FP32 softmax; no SDPA path in this model forward.
audio_tower_source_geometry.attention_dtype_implication: model/input/linear/conv weights are BF16; internal attention matmuls/softmax include FP32 ops, the only target of the temporary TF32 precision experiment.

prefix_no_padding_ablation.interpretation_limit: Each prefix is independently position-encoded from index 0; this isolates left padding/truncation but is not the fixed-window serving contract.

60.method: one eager forward with per-module CUDA events and host hook durations; hooks add diagnostic overhead

torch_profiler.scope: ATen operator aggregates grouped by input shape; operator names are not asserted to equal individual CUDA kernels

60.event_interpretation: Eager module event intervals include GPU queue idle/launch-dispatch gaps while Python issues operators; their sum is not pure kernel time and can exceed CUDA Graph replay. Use per-op profiler values for operator attribution and graph replay for serving-path latency.
